==Early life and education==
Witold Kazimierz Roter was born on September 20, 1932, in Zabrze-Pawłów{{r|ZOlszak2016}}. He attended primary and then secondary school in Zabrze, and next, he studied mathematics at the [[Wrocław University|University of Wrocław]] – 1st degree studies in 1950–1953 and 2nd degree studies (extramural) in 1955–1958. In 1958 he obtained a master's degree in mathematics. In 1953, after completing the first cycle of studies, he was ordered to work as a teacher at the Nowa Ruda Primary School No. 1 and in the Secondary School{{r|ZOlszak2016}}. He worked there until 1961.<ref name = prof>{{cite journal |url=https://www.noworudzianin.pl/WWW/2017/05/26/skwer-rotera/|title=''Skwer Rotera''|journal=Noworudzianin |volume=281|pages=7|year=2017|language=pl|access-date=March 6, 2021}}</ref> In the same year, he was accepted as a senior assistant at the Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry of the University of Wrocław{{r|ZOlszak2016}}.

Witold Kazimierz Roter died on June 19, 2015, in [[Wrocław]]. He is buried at [[Osobowice Cemetery]]{{r|WRgrave}} in [[Wrocław]]
[[File:Witold Roter (1932-2015) 1.jpg|thumb|240 px|left|Witold Roter. A stone pillar in [[Nowa Ruda]]]]

==Academic career==
In 1963 at the [[Wrocław University]] he defended his doctoral thesis "On certain properties of recursive and weak-recursive spaces" written under the supervision of [[Władysław Ślebodziński]],<ref name=PhDgenWR>{{mathgenealogy|112337}}</ref> and in 1974 he obtained his habilitation. He was awarded the title of professor of mathematical sciences in 1992. He was an employee of the Mathematical Institute of the [[Wrocław University|University of Wrocław]], where he was deputy director of the Mathematical Institute, vice-dean of the Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, and for many years he headed the Department of Geometry,<ref name=WKR2016UWr>{{cite web | url = http://www.wmi.uni.wroc.pl/pl/node/259 | title = ''Żegnamy prof. Witolda Rotera'' | access-date = April 25, 2021 | publisher = [[Uniwersytet Wrocławski]], Wydział Matematyki i Informatyki | language = pl | archive-date = May 2, 2021 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20210502111118/http://www.wmi.uni.wroc.pl/pl/node/259 | url-status = dead }}</ref> and the Institute of Mathematics of the Wrocław University of Technology{{r|ZOlszak2016}}.

In the years 1989–1991 he was the president of the Wrocław Branch of [[Polish Mathematical Society]], and in the years 1996–2004 the president of the Scholarship Foundation of Wrocław Mathematicians.{{Cn|date=May 2025}}

==Contributions==
Andrzej Derdiński writes about his contribution to the development of differential geometry.<ref name=Adredzinski2017>{{cite journal | doi = 10.4064/cm7409s-9-2017 | last1 = Derdziński | first1 = Andrzej |volume=150| issue = 1 | journal = Colloquium Mathematicum | pages = 1––8 | title = Witold Roter (1932--2015) | year = 2017|issn=0010-1354}}</ref><ref name=Adredzinski2016>{{cite journal 
    | last1 = Derdziński
    |first1 = Andrzej
    | title = On the scientific achievements of Witold Roter
  |journal  = Wiadomości Matematyczne
  | volume  = 52
     | year = 2016
   | pages = 299–313
   | issn  = 2080-5519
   |  issue=2| doi = 10.14708/wm.v52i2.3299}}</ref><ref name=ZOlszak2016>{{cite journal
| last1 = Olszak
    |first1 = Zbigniew
    | title = Witold Kazimierz Roter (1932-2015)
  |journal  = Wiadomości Matematyczne
  | volume  = 52
     | year = 2016
   | number = 1
   | pages = 153–157
   | issn  = 2080-5519
   | doi = 10.14708/wm.v52i1.3383}}</ref> Since 1961 he published more than 36 scientific papers. A summary of his most important works can be found in Mathematical Reviews<ref name=MathSciNet>{{cite web | url =https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/search/author.html?mrauthid=231446 | title =List of publications in MathSciNet | last =Roter | first =Witold Kazimierz | year =1961 | publisher =American Mathematical Society | language =en | access-date= April 19, 2021}}</ref> and Zentralblatt fur Mathematik.<ref name=StTrZBL>{{cite web | url =https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai%3Aroter.witold | title =List of publications in zbMATH |author=Witold Kazimierz Roter | year =1961 |publisher =FIZ Karlsruhe GmbH | language =en  | access-date = February 19, 2021}}</ref>

==Honors and awards==
He was awarded the Gold Cross of Merit and the Knight's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta.  In 1983 he was awarded the Tadeusz Ważewski Prize<ref name=TW1983PTM>{{cite web | url =https://www.ptm.org.pl/laureaci/witold-roter | title ="Laureates of Tadeusz Ważewski's Prize" | last1 =Roter | first1 =Witold | date =1983 | language =pl | access-date = May 2, 2021}}</ref>

June 2, 2017, at the Secondary School im. Henryk Sienkiewicz in [[Nowa Ruda]], a plaque dedicated to the professor was unveiled, and an obelisk with a commemorative plaque{{r|prof}} was unveiled in the square at the Market Square, which was named after Roter.
